subject: world_language
concept: Unit review and mastery check for routines, hobbies, directions, family, plans, and short comprehension
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Mixed set of routine and hobby vocabulary questions spanning nodes 01-07
exercise.abstract: Mixed directions, family, plans, and multi-turn conversation questions spanning nodes 01-07

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed question types, plus a passing conversation sample
misconception_flags: any single-node misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
next_node_on_fail: WORLDLANG.P4.EXPANDING_CONVERSATIONS.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
